## 1. forest against gbm (v29, the same rows; each kind at its own knob, as protal calls)
bootstrap: 1,000 resamples of the samples; P(gbm better): the share of resamples where gbm's F1 is higher.
matched FP: the true positives each kind reaches at the other's false-positive count (its best threshold).

## 2. v29 against v27 on the test samples both builds simulated alike
alike: a sample name of both builds whose present taxa (rows with truth 1) overlap by 95% of their union or more. Its present taxa are the union: one without a row in a build is a false negative there (a gate's lost species). Each model at its own knob, as protal calls. v27's models are gbm (its default then); v29's forest is its database's default.
